cohort: 46,989 individuals with singleton pregnancies who delivered after 28 weeks of gestation
finding: Gestational glucose intolerance in pregnancy is associated with birth weight-related adverse pregnancy outcomes, including LGA.
mod_finding: The odds of birth weight-related adverse outcomes (including cesarean delivery, severe perineal lacerations, and shoulder dystocia or clavicular fracture) were higher in pregnant individuals with gestational glucose intolerance with one abnormal OGTT value than in those with normal glucose tolerance.
